1070|bd6c9aff.name: Deputy Feldon
1070|bd6c9aff.text: You'll find the town of Lakeshire yonder, across the bridge. But you'll not find it a peaceful place. If you're here for adventure, lad, then mark me--you've found it!

1287|ed056522.name: Marda Weller
1287|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1287|fe52f4ea.name: Marda Weller
1287|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1317|f472d1d3.name: Lucan Cordell
1317|f472d1d3.text: A true professional know his limitations, and I'm not ashamed to admit that your skills exceed mine. I want you to pay a visit to Kitta Firewind at the Tower of Azora. She is well-renowned, and with good reason.

1318|0624ab70.name: Jessara Cordell
1318|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

15310|d11310f6.name: Jesper
15310|d11310f6.text: I'm sad!  It's Hallow's End, and I'm sick.  I'm going to miss out on trick-or-treating because I can't go out!

2327|2957a3a0.name: Shaina Fuller
2327|2957a3a0.text: Oh, a fellow Physician. I would be glad to teach you anything that would aid your journeys.

2409|c5ceacbe.name: Felicia Maline
2409|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2455|105cd232.name: Olivia Burnside
2455|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2455|2237a3b1.name: Olivia Burnside
2455|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

256390|6a190ff9.name: Marcy Baker
256390|6a190ff9.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

256732|9285f4a0.name: Alynsia
256732|9285f4a0.text: You look like you could use a few enchants. You have come to the right place!

264|b3b21323.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
264|b3b21323.text: At ease, $C.  If you are just passing though I suggest you stick to the roads and only travel by day. If your business is here in Darkshire, consider lending your abilities to The Night Watch.  Our skill is unquestionable but our numbers are small.

265|94d9e780.name: Madame Eva
265|94d9e780.text: I have sensed your coming for quite some time, $N.  It was written in the pattern of the stars.

295|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Farley
295|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

3087|52392408.name: Crystal Boughman
3087|52392408.text: Seek out Shandrina in Silverwind Refuge.  She can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".

3136|e91b638d.name: Clarise Gnarltree
3136|e91b638d.text: Don't come out of the shadows like that. Next time give a girl some warning.

344|d18fd3a5.name: Magistrate Solomon
344|d18fd3a5.text: Who is this $c who goes before the Court of Lakshire in the Kingdom of Stormwind?  State your business within this township, $R.  The orc threat to the Kingdom is far too great to squander time in idle conversation.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

376|bab8ec77.name: High Priestess Laurena
376|bab8ec77.text: I trust the Light is with you, $N. Is there something that I can I help you with?

381|50146e32.name: Dockmaster Baren
381|50146e32.text: Well met, $C.  If you're here for business, then get yourself a brew and we'll have ourselves a talk.

382|04802d87.name: Marshal Marris
382|04802d87.text: I don't have time to chat, citizen, but if you're willing to give us a hand against the orcs, then I'll find a use for you.

415|fca64b70.name: Verner Osgood
415|fca64b70.text: Hey buddy, do you think you could give me a hand with something?  I'm really in dire straits here...

514|aa4da6d8.name: Smith Argus
514|aa4da6d8.text: If you'd like to learn how to blacksmith your own weapons and armor, I'd be happy to help.

633|b8d58f51.name: Elaine Carevin
633|b8d58f51.text: It's dark times that have come, $c... All too soon will we lose everything... When the Light will forsake all but those who truly walk under the Light.

6727|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Brianna
6727|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

6790|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Trelayne
6790|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

8931|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Heather
8931|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

101-accept.name: Madame Eva
101-accept.text:
As the mystical taint creeps through the forest, the need for self-protection is undeniable, $N.  The winds whisper to me and they speak of a great danger which waits patiently for you in the near future.

If you wish to protect yourself, noble $c, bring to me 10 ghoul fangs, 10 skeleton fingers and 5 vials of spider venom.  For you I shall enchant a Totem of Infliction which will harm those who attempt violent acts against you.
101-accept.title: The Totem of Infliction

115-accept.name: Marshal Marris
115-accept.text:
The Blackrock orcs enlisted shadowcasters to aid their attacks in Redridge, and they have brought with them devices of dark power--midnight orbs.  These orbs have struck telling blows against Redridge's defenders, and it's imperative we remove the demon-tainted items from the conflict.

Find and deliver to me midnight orbs from slain Blackrock shadowcasters.  I will then have them disposed of, for this world would be a better place without them!
115-accept.title: Shadow Magic

115-complete.name: Marshal Marris
115-complete.text: Thank you, $N.  I'll send these to be destroyed immediately.
115-complete.title: Shadow Magic

115-progress.name: Marshal Marris
115-progress.text: How goes your conflict with the shadowcasters?  Did you find the midnight orbs?
115-progress.title: Shadow Magic

118-complete.name: Smith Argus
118-complete.text: Heh, so old Verner needs some shoes, does he!?!
118-complete.title: The Price of Shoes

118-progress.name: Smith Argus
118-progress.text: What's that?  Verner sent you, you say?  Well give me his note.  And SPEAK UP!
118-progress.title: The Price of Shoes

119-accept.name: Smith Argus
119-accept.text:
Ok, I'll give him his 50 horseshoes...

Here they are, all boxed up and ready to go!  Tell Verner it was a pleasure doing business, and be sure he reads the note attached to this crate!
119-accept.title: Return to Verner

119-complete.name: Verner Osgood
119-complete.text:
Thank you, this really helps me out.

But what's this?  Argus sent a note with the crate...What??  Argus wants me to PAY him?  Bah!

Well, $N, thank you for your help.
119-complete.title: Return to Verner

119-progress.name: Verner Osgood
119-progress.text: Great, you're back!  Did you get the shoes?
119-progress.title: Return to Verner

122-accept.name: Verner Osgood
122-accept.text:
I need some underbelly scales from black dragon whelps to pay for the shoes Argus sent me from Goldshire.  If you can get 6 of them for me, then I can pay Argus with some... and have enough left to fashion something for you.

Black dragon whelps are often flying around south of Lakeshire, but they like to wander.  You might have to just keep an eye out and hunt them when you see them.
122-accept.title: Underbelly Scales

122-complete.name: Verner Osgood
122-complete.text: Thanks!  These will get me out of debt to Argus...
122-complete.title: Underbelly Scales

122-progress.name: Verner Osgood
122-progress.text: I know that greedy Argus will send someone to collect his scales if I don't give them to him soon.  Have you found those scales yet?
122-progress.title: Underbelly Scales

124-accept.name: Verner Osgood
124-accept.text:
As if the attacking orcs weren't enough!  Now I have gnoll brutes and mystics prowling along the ridge north of my stable, taking my horses when they stray...

If you can get rid of those gnolls, my horses and I would be very grateful.
124-accept.title: A Baying of Gnolls

124-complete.name: Verner Osgood
124-complete.text: Thank you for all your help, $N.
124-complete.title: A Baying of Gnolls

126-accept.name: Verner Osgood
126-accept.text:
$N, the gnolls are still out there.  I can hear their baying as they hunt in the hills above Lakeshire.  And one cry is louder than the rest - Yowler,  their leader.

Kill Yowler and send his pack scattering!  Bring me his paw as proof.

And be careful, this gnoll is their leader for a reason.  He is no Mongrel...
126-accept.title: Howling in the Hills

126-complete.name: Verner Osgood
126-complete.text: Again, thank you for your help.  The Stormwind army is so busy dealing with the orcs, they don't have the troops to protect Redridge from local threats like the gnolls.
126-complete.title: Howling in the Hills

126-progress.name: Verner Osgood
126-progress.text: Yowler is a dangerous creature, $N.  If you're not ready for him, I understand.
126-progress.title: Howling in the Hills

127-complete.name: Dockmaster Baren
127-complete.text: Pleasure doin' business with you, matey!
127-complete.title: Selling Fish

127-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
127-progress.text: You have some sunfish for me, eh?
127-progress.title: Selling Fish

128-complete.name: Guard Howe
128-complete.text: I see you have fought valiantly against the Blackrock Clan, $C.  Your service to our township is great indeed.
128-complete.title: Blackrock Bounty

150-complete.name: Dockmaster Baren
150-complete.text:
Well done, $N.  I hope you didn't have too much trouble with those murlocs.

It's strange seeing them so far from the sea.  I wonder if they're here because they're running from something...
150-complete.title: Murloc Poachers

150-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
150-progress.text: Do you have those fins?  Hurry, we need those murlocs driven from the lake!
150-progress.title: Murloc Poachers

163-accept.name: Elaine Carevin
163-accept.text:
Something's amiss at Raven Hill, $N. Calor swears that someone--or something--is haunting the buildings there. Two nights running he's noticed the shadows moving, and the third before that he says he saw light in one of the windows.

If, as you say, you care about the safety of Duskwood, find out what monster haunts in Raven Hill.
163-accept.title: Raven Hill

164-accept.name: Elaine Carevin
164-accept.text:
Do you know Sven? Now, there is a man who does the work of the Light! He and his followers keep a camp at the northwestern edge of Duskwood.

Unfortunately, because they are so few, they cannot even spare a man to fetch supplies from town. Will you deliver these supplies to him?
164-accept.title: Deliveries to Sven

165-accept.name: Elaine Carevin
165-accept.text: There was an old man who used to come into town to buy supplies rather frequently, but I haven't seen him for quite some time now. He lives out in a shack overlooking Raven Hill cemetery, if I remember correctly. Perhaps you should go see if something is amiss.
165-accept.title: The Hermit

169-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
169-complete.text: Fantastic work, $N!  Gath'Ilzogg led those brutes into battle, killing many innocent humans.  Vindication is ours.  This is the first step in reclaiming the keep for the kingdom of Stormwind!
169-complete.title: WANTED: Gath'Ilzogg

173-accept.name: Calor
173-accept.text:
Darkness seems drawn inexorably to Duskwood. Master Carevin's quest is the expulsion of evil and heresy. Through our efforts are the people of Darkshire kept safe.

You believe yourself worthy to join us?

I once thought as you. Disillusioned by the complacency of the Watch, I joined Master Carevin. If you wish to prove yourself, it will not be through words.

Test your skills against the Nightbane Shadow Weaver worgen in Brightwood Grove--bright, hah!--and the Rotting Orchard.
173-accept.title: Worgen in the Woods

174-accept.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
174-accept.text:
My Gnomish friend, Cog, has promised to help me build a device which will let me peer towards the stars.  A truth exists, beyond magic, that can explain the strange transformation in the forest.

Bring to me a bronze tube made by a skilled engineer.  That is the first step, according to Cog's blueprint.
174-accept.title: Look to the Stars

174-complete.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
174-complete.text: This is perfect, $N.  The first step is complete!
174-complete.title: Look to the Stars

174-progress.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
174-progress.text: Have you found a skilled engineer to create a bronze tube yet?
174-progress.title: Look to the Stars

175-accept.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
175-accept.text: According to Cog's blueprint, what I need now is a way to reflect light.  I remember a woman by the name of Mary who became well known around these parts for always carrying a looking glass.  Perhaps you can track Mary down and see if she might lend us a reflective surface for this project?  I believe she once resided in southern Duskwood. . .
175-accept.title: Look to the Stars

180-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
180-complete.text: So the evil Lieutenant Fangore is dead?  Good riddance to that foul creature.  You are very brave, $c.  The Township of Lakeshire thanks you for your aid.
180-complete.title: WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore

180-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
180-progress.text: What news do you bring before the Court?
180-progress.title: WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore

19-accept.name: Marshal Marris
19-accept.text: Blackrock Outrunners and Renegades are running ambushes between here and Stonewatch Keep.  The leader of the Outrunners is an orc named Tharil'zun--we want this orc.  Bring me the head of Tharil'zun!
19-accept.title: Tharil'zun

19-complete.name: Marshal Marris
19-complete.text: Tharil'zun was a vicious, crafty orc.  Well done--I'm sure he didn't go down easy.  Here is your reward, $N.
19-complete.title: Tharil'zun

19-progress.name: Marshal Marris
19-progress.text: Orc pressure from Blackrock is still tense.  But have you at least rid us of Tharil'zun?
19-progress.title: Tharil'zun

20-complete.name: Marshal Marris
20-complete.text: That makes for a lot fewer orcs to worry about, thanks.
20-complete.title: Blackrock Menace

20-progress.name: Marshal Marris
20-progress.text: Have you been slaying orcs, $N?  If so, then show me...
20-progress.title: Blackrock Menace

219-complete.name: Marshal Marris
219-complete.text: You have served the Kingdom well, $C.  Thank you for assisting Corporal Keeshan with his escape from those dreaded Blackrock Orcs.  You shall be rewarded for your brave acts this day.
219-complete.title: Missing In Action

246-complete.name: Deputy Feldon
246-complete.text:
<Deputy Feldon listens to your report...>

There's a sizable force of gnolls encamped there, and from what you tell me they are tough ones.  It must not have been easy for you to gather this intelligence.

Here you are, $N.  We are grateful for your aid.

And if you haven't already done so, speak with Marshal Marris and Magistrate Solomon within Lakeshire.  Our situation grows ever more desperate - those two will have need of you I'm sure.
246-complete.title: Assessing the Threat

346-accept.name: Brother Paxton
346-accept.text: Now that I've finished copying the book, here's the original Stresses of Iron.  Thank you for your patience, and if you see Milton please tell him I'm sorry for the long delay.
346-accept.title: Return to Kristoff

346-complete.name: Brother Kristoff
346-complete.text: That's the one!  Thank you, $N.  May the Light shine brightly upon both your body and spirit!
346-complete.title: Return to Kristoff

346-progress.name: Brother Kristoff
346-progress.text: Were you able to find the book?
346-progress.title: Return to Kristoff

347-complete.name: Brother Paxton
347-complete.text:
Oh, splendid!  I can use this ore to make my dye, and then can finish copying The Stresses of Iron.

Thank you, $N!
347-complete.title: Rethban Ore

347-progress.name: Brother Paxton
347-progress.text: Do you have the Rethban Ore?
347-progress.title: Rethban Ore

377-accept.name: Councilman Millstipe
377-accept.text:
As if the neglect for the residents of Duskwood was not bad enough, now the House of Nobles spits in the eye of the Darkshire Council with their decision to imprison Dextren Ward in Stormwind rather than behead the villain as per Lord Ebonlocke's sentence.

Ward was caught selling bodies from the cemetery to Morbent Fel, a crime punishable by death.  Yet Stormwind claims Ward as their prisoner.

Assassinate Ward in The Stormwind Stockade - bring me his hand - and I shall reward you.
377-accept.title: Crime and Punishment

386-accept.name: Guard Berton
386-accept.text:
Targorr the Dread served under Gath'Ilzogg as supreme Executioner.  His methods were ruthless, even by filthy orc standards.  Men who fought bravely to defend the Kingdom were tortured on his whim.  Now he is being held in the Stormwind Stockade, sentenced to die.  Yet something is amiss.  One of the bureaucratic nobles put a hold on his execution.  I am sure foul play is in the works.

Put an end to Targorr the Dread, $N.  Travel to The Stockade and behead him before trickery is upon us.
386-accept.title: What Comes Around...

66-accept.name: Madame Eva
66-accept.text:
Last night a horrible disturbance rippled through my veins.  I sensed that my granddaughter, Alyssa, was in great danger.  I consulted the cards and Death stared up at me from the table.

After taking a long journey through a dark trance I was able to uncover a clue to this terrifying mystery.  A name came to me, the name of Stalvan.

Seek out the Clerk in the Town Hall and see if you can find out more about this character.  I fear for us all.
66-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

66-complete.name: Clerk Daltry
66-complete.text: Ah so Madame Eva sent you. . . .
66-complete.title: The Legend of Stalvan

67-accept.name: Clerk Daltry
67-accept.text:
Stalvan, eh?  Let me check the town registry.

Stalvan. . .Stalvan. . .let's see.  Ah, here we go!  I have a record of a Mr. Stalvan Mistmantle.  The last recorded address is the Moonbrook Schoolhouse.  My, talk about outdated!

Do me a favor will you, friend?  If you happen to go out to Moonbrook, let me know if you get any update on this fellow.  I like to keep the records clean.
67-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

68-accept.name: Unknown
68-accept.text: You find a Dusty Unsent Letter in the old footlocker.
68-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

68-complete.name: Clerk Daltry
68-complete.text: Interesting.  So the chap did spend some time in Moonbrook after all.  It is rather odd the letter never got delivered.  Nonetheless, I shall update the registry.
68-complete.title: The Legend of Stalvan

68-progress.name: Clerk Daltry
68-progress.text: Ah, I remember you.  You're the one who was asking about that Stalvan fellow.  Did you ever find what you were looking for?
68-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

69-accept.name: Clerk Daltry
69-accept.text: Oh my!  Must have missed this the first time.  In the registry, right beneath the first address for Stalvan there's another one listed, only partially scratched out.  Looks like he was headed to The Lion's Pride Inn over in Goldshire.  Might want to check there, $N.
69-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

70-accept.name: Innkeeper Farley
70-accept.text:
The name Stalvan rings a bell.  I remember now.

Many years back, on a stormy night, a messenger came in, seeking refuge for the night.  Near the stroke of midnight, the man ran down the stairs screaming, his face pale with fear.  Still wearing his bedclothes, he disappeared into the downpour.

In his haste he forgot his letters in the chest upstairs.  He never returned for them. One remains from that Stalvan fellow, intended for the Canal District in Stormwind.  Help yourself to it.
70-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

70-complete.name: Caretaker Folsom
70-complete.text: You've got some nerve bringing this here.
70-complete.title: The Legend of Stalvan

70-progress.name: Caretaker Folsom
70-progress.text: What have ya got there?  Let me take a look at that. . .
70-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

72-accept.name: Caretaker Folsom
72-accept.text:
My father was the caretaker of the estate long before I was.  He had to mop the blood up after the massacre.  But that's neither here nor there.

The last funds of the Flintridge trust have dried up.  Now the last of the family possessions are headed for auction.  Blame the tax vultures.  I guess if you're really itching to learn more you're free to look through this junk.  Who knows what you might find.
72-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

72-complete.name: Unknown
72-complete.text: You slowly slide the lid of the crate off. . . .
72-complete.title: The Legend of Stalvan

74-accept.name: Unknown
74-accept.text: Inside the crate you find various objects: musty heirlooms, a family portrait, a few hunting trophies and some old books.  Near the bottom, underneath a ceramic vase, you uncover A Torn Journal Page.
74-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

74-complete.name: Marshal Haggard
74-complete.text: I can barely make out those letters.  But that writing style reminds me of something I once saw before my vision became so poor.
74-complete.title: The Legend of Stalvan

74-progress.name: Marshal Haggard
74-progress.text: What have you got there?  I cannot see.  My eyesight is very bad.  Put it in my hands.
74-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

75-accept.name: Marshal Haggard
75-accept.text:
There was a bundle of parchments in the chest upstairs when I moved into this place.  I looked at them once when I first arrived but I gave up once the fog hazed over my peepers. 

Do an old, nearly-blind man a favor and check the chest upstairs for anything that might help you in your quest to discover more about this Stalvan character.  I'm pretty sure there's a faded journal page that might be of interest to you.  Bring it to me and I'll help in anyway I can.
75-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

75-progress.name: Marshal Haggard
75-progress.text: Did you find that page I mentioned, $N?
75-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

78-accept.name: Marshal Haggard
78-accept.text: I know of someone who might be able to assist you.  Back when I was leading the Stormwind Guard, we used to get drinks at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire.  The Innkeeper there, Smitts, was quite an expert on the local lore.  Show him this page and see what he has to say about it.
78-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

78-complete.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
78-complete.text: By the Light!  You bet I recognize that handwriting.
78-complete.title: The Legend of Stalvan

78-progress.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
78-progress.text:
Marshal Haggard sent you?  Why didn't you say so? 

Ah, good ol' Haggard.  Poor chap is going to be completely blind before long.  Anyway, let me see what you've got there.
78-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

79-accept.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
79-accept.text: I followed the legend of that Stalvan character for years.  When those visiting nobles were slaughtered a few years back I went with Haggard to investigate.  I found these muddy pages but we were never able to link the handwriting to that crazy man in the woods.  Your trail of evidence proves his guilt.  Take this to Commander Ebonlocke immediately and fill her in on what you've discovered!
79-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

79-complete.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
79-complete.text: My, you have proved yourself to be quite a detective, $c.
79-complete.title: The Legend of Stalvan

79-progress.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
79-progress.text: This better be good, $c.  Let me see what you have and tell me your tale.  But by the Light, be quick about it.  Darkshire's defense is my number one priority.  I have not the time to squander on dead-end leads.
79-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

80-accept.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
80-accept.text:
I have had my eye on that creep, Stalvan, for quite sometime.  But if this page was written by the same hand it proves his guilt beyond a shadow of a doubt.

In all his days keeping the Town Registry, Clerk Daltry has become an expert at identifying handwriting.  Show him this page and see if the writing matches that of the registry signature.
80-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

80-complete.name: Clerk Daltry
80-complete.text: Why yes!  The writing on this page does in fact match that of the registry signatures.
80-complete.title: The Legend of Stalvan

80-progress.name: Clerk Daltry
80-progress.text: Back again, $N?  What do you have this time?
80-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

8311-accept.name: Jesper
8311-accept.text:
I want to go trick-or-treating, but I can't because I'm sick.  If you go for me, I'd trade you the candy you get for some I already have!  I think you'd like this candy - it makes you turn into things both funny and scary!

Each of the innkeepers in the big cities have candy they give for Hallow's End - talk to them and do the tricks they ask for!  Also, a little $r named Talvash in Ironforge is handing out candy as well.  When you have all the candy, bring them back to me here!
8311-accept.title: Hallow's End Treats for Jesper!

89-complete.name: Foreman Oslow
89-complete.text: Great work, $N.  These supplies will help the bridge effort immensely.  We'll get this beauty shored up in no time.
89-complete.title: The Everstill Bridge

89-progress.name: Foreman Oslow
89-progress.text: This bridge isn't going to build itself!  Now where are those iron pikes and iron rivets?
89-progress.title: The Everstill Bridge

90-progress.name: Chef Grual
90-progress.text: Were you able to find 10 Lean Wolf Flanks yet?
90-progress.title: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs

91-complete.name: Bailiff Conacher
91-complete.text: The Court of Lakeshire recognizes your commitment to justice, $N.  By enforcing the laws of the Kingdom you have helped uphold the justice of the land.
91-complete.title: Solomon's Law

91-progress.name: Bailiff Conacher
91-progress.text: Turn in 10 Shadowhide Pendants to me, and you shall be rewarded.
91-progress.title: Solomon's Law

92-complete.name: Chef Breanna
92-complete.text: Well done, $N. Such fine specimens too! And here is your delicious delicacy known as Redridge Goulash!
92-complete.title: Redridge Goulash

92-progress.name: Chef Breanna
92-progress.text: I still need five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
92-progress.title: Redridge Goulash

97-accept.name: Clerk Daltry
97-accept.text: Let Commander Ebonlocke know immediately that the handwriting matched, $N!  Her suspicions were correct!
97-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

98-accept.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
98-accept.text:
Stalvan Mistmantle led a life of depravity.  Innocent victims died by his hand.  Undoubtedly he is guilty of countless crimes.  Now the lunatic threatens Darkshire.  The Light only knows what sordid acts he is plotting.  Travel to his cottage just north of town, $C, and execute Stalvan, once and for all.

When the deed is done, travel to Madame Eva's and show her his family ring.  After all, it was her premonition that led to this gruesome discovery.  But Darkshire is safer because of her.
98-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

98386-progress.name: Foreman Oslow
98386-progress.text: A bite from one of the tarantulas out here can leave a worker out with a fever for a week. I'd prefer that didn't happen. At least, not on my watch.
98386-progress.title: Alther's Mill

98387-progress.name: Marshal Marris
98387-progress.text: Most of what you find will have been raided from Lakeshire anyway. It will do me good to know our people will thrive while the orcs wither.
98387-progress.title: Blackrock Blockade

98407-progress.name: Deputy Feldon
98407-progress.text: A full assessment of the gnolls cannot be complete without facing the worst of their kind. Put those thrashers down!
98407-progress.title: Show of Force
